component.subject: Prayer for Unity
component.author: Russell Allen
component.source: Original composition by Russell Allen, released under CC0. Echoes Acts 17:26, Ephesians 2:14, Philippians 4:7 and Galatians 3:28.

block.p: God, you have made of one blood all nations of the earth, and your will is that all your children should be gathered into one family of love: break down, we pray you, the walls that divide us; deliver us from hardness of heart and from contempt for those who differ from us; and hasten the time when all shall dwell together in that peace which passes understanding, knowing you as Father and one another as brothers and sisters; through Jesus Christ our Lord, in whom there is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, but all are one. Amen.
